JUDGE BURST K3-jdg-01 — the Keeper's first loops (idle-S, walk-S): identity persistence across frames, motion plausibility, light (JUDGE_RUBRIC axes; charter § 7 K3). task_id "K3-jdg-01". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Image 1 = the IDLE strip: 8 registered frames left to right (0–7; frame 7 = frame 0, the loop return). Image 2 = the WALK strip: 8 registered frames (0–7) of an in-place walk toward the camera. Image 3 = a THIRD strip, 8 frames, judge it exactly like the others (do not assume any strip is a control). Image 4 = the approved master (identity). Image 5 = light anchor (key from screen upper-left).
For EACH strip score axes 1–5 (integers): 1 register fidelity to the master · 2 IDENTITY PERSISTENCE across the 8 frames (face, hair mass, every costume item and ITS SIDE — staff RIGHT hand, satchel LEFT hip — in every frame; a strip whose sides are swapped is mirrored: score ≤ 2 and say 'mirrored') · 3 light obedience (key upper-left in every frame; a strip lit from upper-right scores ≤ 2) · 4 silhouette read at 64 px across the loop · 5 brush-register consistency across frames. ADD for the walk strip: the lead-foot sequence you SEE frame by frame (R/L/passing/high), whether the leads alternate correctly with no repeated lead, and whether frame 7 flows into frame 0. ADD for the idle strip: whether the motion is a plausible subtle breath and whether frame 7→0 pops.
Write out/judgment.json: {"strips":[{"image":1,"kind":"idle","axes":{…},"reasons":{…},"mirrored":false,"loop_pops":false,"notes":"…"},{"image":2,"kind":"walk","axes":{…},"reasons":{…},"mirrored":false,"lead_sequence":[…],"leads_alternate":true,"loop_pops":false},{"image":3,…}]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K3-jdg-01"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — scores only.
